methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched directly for each vendor on 2026-06-15 and adversarially verified: clio.com/pricing, mycase.com/pricing, practicepanther.com/pricing, smokeball.com/pricing, rocketmatter.com/pricing, caretlegal.com/pricing, cosmolex.com/pricing, filevine.com/pricing, centerbase.com/pricing. Compliance was verified only from each vendor's own security page; claims attributable solely to the cloud-infrastructure provider (e.g. AWS SOC 2) were NOT credited to the vendor. Prices shown are as published on official pages; where a vendor's pricing page omits dollar amounts and directs to sales, monthlyUsd is set to null (a null beats a guess). Where a page shows both monthly-billed and annually-billed per-user rates, monthlyUsd reflects the month-to-month rate and annualDiscountPct reflects the annual-billing savings. All vendors and prices in the draft were confirmed to exist on live official pages; zero vendors were fabricated. All data accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Clio
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from clio.com/pricing; only EasyStart ($49/user/mo) is publicly listed — Essentials, Advanced, and Expand require contacting sales or booking a demo. Compliance verified from clio.com/security which explicitly states HIPAA support, annual SOC 2 Type II (and SOC 1 Type II), and GDPR compliance.

plans.name: EasyStart
plans.notes: Per user per month; page shows 'Starting at $49/user'. Includes core time tracking, billing, document management, e-signatures, secure client communications. 7-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per user, 'Get Pricing' — no dollar amount published. Adds document/matter templates, client portal, 250+ app integrations, text-to-pay.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per user, 'Get Pricing' — no dollar amount published. Adds task automation, custom reports, live onboarding, priority support.

plans.name: Expand
plans.notes: Per user, 'Book a Demo' — no dollar amount published. Bundles Clio Manage + Clio Grow. Adds lead capture, CRM tools, marketing ROI tracking.

limits: Only EasyStart plan has a publicly listed price ($49/user/mo); all other tiers require contacting sales or booking a demo
keyFeatures: 250+ app integrations on Essentials and above
Built-in e-signatures and client portal
Clio Grow CRM available as add-on or bundled in Expand
Annual SOC 2 Type II and SOC 1 Type II audits
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from clio.com/pricing (only EasyStart priced). Compliance from clio.com/security confirming explicit HIPAA support, annual SOC 2 Type II, and GDPR.

plans.name: Basic

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per user. $120/user/mo billed monthly; $100/user/mo billed annually. Adds AI writing/document assistant, unlimited eSignature, automated workflows, client intake forms, legal CRM, 2-way texting, 70+ integrations.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per user. $150/user/mo billed monthly; $130/user/mo billed annually. Adds AI case assistant, AI discovery assistant with OCR, advanced document automation, Desktop Drive, conflict check, split billing, open API.

limits: Open API only on Advanced plan
70+ integrations only on Pro and Advanced
keyFeatures: AI-powered writing, document, and case assistants
Unlimited eSignature on Pro and above
Built-in legal CRM with client intake forms
10-day free trial, no credit card required
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from mycase.com/pricing with explicit monthly and annual per-user rates. Security page asserts only PCI and IOLTA — HIPAA/SOC 2/GDPR not claimed, so left null.

vendors.name: Smokeball

Integrations from marketplace.smokeball.com.

plans.notes: 'From $149/mo' starting figure only; exact price requires a quote. Adds cloud-based case management: client/matter management, task management, Microsoft 365 integration, client portal, eSignature, eFiling. Free trial is for the Boost plan.

ISO 27001 certified organization

keyFeatures: SOC 2 Type 2 stated on pricing page
